canvas.note: The dev box's tiling WM forces every client window to the same tile size (observed 634x675 on both 1.19.2 and 1.20.6 despite --width 1280 --height 720). The diff invariant is therefore: both captures have IDENTICAL dimensions. run.sh diff asserts that before diffing; if they differ, it reports the mismatch instead of diffing.

fixture.spawnSource: server log line: 'logged in with entity id N at (x, y, z)'
fixture.note: Fresh NORMAL world per side. Flag placed at the world spawn via the console command `_qtdev townplace <x> <y-1> <z>`; the townie spawned with `_qtdev townspawn <x> <y-1> <z>` (owner paths: TownFlags.register + SpawnVisitorReward.spawnNew). No tp across distance - a long tp desyncs client/server Y by ~64 in this box and kills the player; the death screen then gets captured as a 'screen'.

screens.name: parent
screens.note: InventoryAndStatusMenu = the tabbed parent (tabs + inventory + status strip)

check.note: content gate: check.sh vision-verifies each screen against its expect block before banking. Distinct file sizes or md5s prove screens differ from each other; only this gate proves they show the right thing.

diff.note: PASS if changed-pixels <= threshold per screen; antialiasing at text edges and the villager face (seeded per entity UUID) are the expected residuals
